annotations.title: Show notes and transcript as text

description: The show notes, the full transcript with speaker labels and the edit summary of an edited podcast episode, as text, with no file to download and parse. Available once barevalue_status reports "done". The include parameter limits the answer to the parts named; the transcript of a long episode is large.

api_key.description: Barevalue API key (bv_sk_...), as returned by barevalue_register. Not needed when the connection already sends an Authorization: Bearer header.

include.description: Optional comma-separated list of summary, show_notes, transcript. All three when omitted.

name: barevalue_content
title: Show notes and transcript as text
